title: Uniform Remix 솔로 #161 · 교복 · 튜브탑 × 앞 레이스업 초미니 · 힐 · USSBBW · 정면 한 손 허리 · 배경 봄 정원 테라스 · 글래스 스킨
prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. ONE woman standing.

a deep ebony-brown complexion, early 20s goddess, USSBBW physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits — an extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person; an immense mass of soft heavy fat sits on her middle, sagging down toward her knees under its own weight, gathering into three or four heavy rounded folds stacked one above the other, deep shadowed creases between them, soft and heavy and slack; a gigantic bust resting on the top fold, her waist lost beneath the folds, colossal hips more than three times the width of her shoulders, each thigh thicker than a normal woman's waist, thick heavy calves; her head looks small on top of her massive body; her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other, long wavy golden blonde hair — wearing a skin-tight micro school uniform set, a strapless cropped tube top of ultra-thin matte crisp white modal jersey with a small navy crest patch on the left of her chest and a slim navy tie hanging from a small knot at the center of its upper edge, her shoulders and arms bare, the front zipper pulled down the center of her chest to the cropped hem and the two sides of the modal jersey fully covering her bust, ending right under her bust with her whole midriff and stomach bare, and an ultra-micro mini skirt of ultra-thin matte pale-grey modal jersey with an open lace-up front, thin ribbon laces criss-crossing over her bare skin from the hem up to the waist, sitting at the top of her hip bones with the hem ending a hand-width below her hip bones. Real photographic skin on her face, neck, arms, hands, stomach, thighs and legs, with visible pores and fine grain, fine peach-fuzz hairs and a faint natural flush on her cheeks and chest, a small mole near her collarbone and fine blue-green veins on the backs of her hands. The garments cling like a second skin and show real material behaviour: the thin modal jersey molded so closely that it shows the soft relief of her collarbones, her hip bones and the gentle rise of her bust and hips, the soft matte drape of the white modal jersey against her bare shoulders and the clean edges of the ribbon laces, fine stretch lines and a soft powdery matte finish. Pose: standing facing the camera straight on, one hand resting on her waist and the other hand relaxed at her side, her legs fully in view — most extreme USSBBW silhouette ever displayed.
Footwear: heels of the most absurdly extreme height imaginable, pointed platform stiletto pumps made of glossy navy leather, each with a razor-thin tapered heel a full forty inches tall and a twelve-inch hidden front platform, her feet arched fully vertical on the very tips of her toes like a dancer on pointe, her legs stretched impossibly long and her whole body lifted far above the ground on them as if standing on stilts.
Nails: the longest nails physically imaginable, coffin nails each as long as her forearm is wide, in navy lacquer with a high polish.
Jewelry: a pair of large chandelier earrings of tin and blackened iron as her only jewelry, her neck, collarbones, chest, arms, wrists and fingers plain bare skin.
Face: her face is bare of any garment — real living flesh with real pores, a soft sheen of natural oils and bright real catchlights, the face of a real Black woman with strong, striking features, a broad nose and full lips, an unmistakably feminine face with a calm, composed expression, makeup: very dewy glass skin with a strong luminous highlight on the cheekbones, nose bridge and forehead, a rosy blush, glossy coral lips.
Skin: the skin of a real living woman photographed with a macro lens at close range, every area of her body showing real pores, fine vellus hairs catching the light, a natural soft sheen of skin oils, subtle natural freckles and small beauty marks scattered across her shoulders, arms, stomach and thighs, a gentle uneven skin tone with a faint blush at the knees and elbows, and a soft warm translucency where the light passes through her skin, sharp enough to read every skin texture detail. Her skin shows sweaty oiled skin, post-workout glistening.

Background: a bright spring garden terrace of pale stone with blooming tulip beds, a low trimmed hedge, a standard-height garden gate and a bench, under a soft overcast sky with gentle diffused light, lit by natural light with soft shadows, the whole floor and surroundings clearly visible and in focus. ONE woman only. Full-length wide shot from a moderate distance with the camera at waist height, the whole figure from the soles of her shoes to the top of her head completely visible, with the door, railing or steps beside her at normal human scale so the extreme heel height reads at a glance, the towering heels clearly separating the shoes from the floor. This is one single photograph taken with one camera at one moment, shot on a medium format camera with an 85mm lens at f/5.6, realistic photographic grain, a real photograph. Portrait 2:3 aspect ratio.
